buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Accounts Officer payable at SBI Sundernagar, SBIN0001138 . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 7. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 10 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification

done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms & C onditions (ATC) 1. Fitment Compatibility Certificate: The bidder shall submit a Fitment Guarantee Certificate durin g technical evaluation, confirming that the offered spare parts are fully compatible with and suitable for fitment in the American Crane CL-79 installed at BBMB, Pandoh. 2. Make in India Compliance: In respect of Non-Make in India (Non-MII) items, the bidder shall subm it relevant documentary evidence in compliance with the prevailing Government of India guidelines. 3. Relevant Experience: The bidder should possess a minimum experience of 05 years (preferably u p to 10 years) in the supply and/or fitment of similar crane spare parts or heavy machinery spares t o Government Departments, PSUs, Boards, Corporations, Autonomous Bodies or other reputed orga nizations. Documentary evidence in support of the claimed experience shall be submitted along wit h the bid. 4. Price Reasonability: The bidder shall furnish a Price Reasonability Certificate along with supportin g documentary evidence of similar supplies made to Government/Semi-Government Departments, P SUs, Boards, Corporations or Autonomous Bodies. 5. Supporting Documents for Price Justification: Documentary evidence for price justification ma y include copies of Purchase Orders, Supply Orders, Contracts, Work Orders, Invoices, Completion C ertificates or Rate Contracts. The purchaser reserves the right to seek further clarification or detaile d justification of the quoted rates from any bidder, including the L-1 bidder. 6. Fitment Warranty: The seller shall provide a minimum warranty of one (01) year on the supplied s pare parts and their fitment, commencing from the date of successful fitment, testing, commissionin g and acceptance by the consignee. 7. Scope of Fitment and Acceptance: The fitment of items at Sr. Nos. 1 to 11 shall be undertaken b y the seller at BBMB, Pandoh Dam, Himachal Pradesh. Final inspection and acceptance shall be carri ed out only after successful fitment and satisfactory testing and performance of the supplied items. 8. Inclusive Rates: The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all expenses towards packing, forwarding, t ransportation, transit insurance, loading, unloading, labour, tools, tackles, consumables, machinery, installation, fitment, testing and commissioning, along with any incidental or ancillary requirements necessary for successful completion of the work. No additional payment or claim on these accounts shall be admissible. 9. Acceptance of Bid Conditions: The bidder shall submit an undertaking on the firm's letterhead, d uly signed and stamped, clearly indicating the GeM Bid Number and Date and confirming unconditio nal acceptance of all technical specifications, bid conditions and ATC clauses without any deviation. 10. Performance Security: Wherever applicable, the successful bidder shall furnish the e-Performanc e Bank Guarantee (e-PBG) in accordance with the GeM General Terms and Conditions and the requir ements specified in the bid. 11. Verification of Documents: The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any doc ument or certificate submitted by the bidder from the issuing authority, OEM or any other concerne d organization. Submission of false, misleading or fabricated documents shall render the bid liable f or rejection and may invite further action as per applicable GeM rules. 12. Quality and Condition of Supplied Items: All spare parts supplied shall be brand new, unused a nd free from manufacturing defects, and shall strictly conform to the technical specifications and re quirements stipulated in the bid. 13. Inspection Rights: The purchaser reserves the right to inspect and verify the offered or supplied it

ems at any stage, either before dispatch or after delivery, to ascertain their conformity with the pre scribed specifications and quality requirements. 14. Non-Compliance: Any failure to comply with the prescribed technical specifications, eligibility requ irements or ATC conditions may render the bid liable for rejection during technical evaluation, in acc ordance with applicable GeM provisions. 15. Submission of ATC Acceptance: The bidder shall upload a duly signed and stamped copy of thes e Buyer Added ATC clauses along with the bid as confirmation of having read, understood and accep ted all the stipulated terms and conditions. .
